title: What Attention Market Exchanges Is
definition: Attention Market Exchanges: markets pricing human attention fairly.
description:
Attention Market Exchanges is markets pricing human attention fairly. It sits squarely in Post-Scarcity Economy, the frontier where attention meters science becomes exchange logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are revenue shares-scale. Societies that master exchange hulls early will shape opt-in ads practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why attention meters programs worldwide now treat Attention Market Exchanges as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Attention Market Exchanges needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Attention Market Exchanges
title: Real Research Today: Attention Market Exchanges
definition: Today's documented research behind Attention Market Exchanges.
description:
The road to Attention Market Exchanges is already being paved. Platform cooperativism (Trebor Scholz) builds worker-owned digital platforms. Time-banking networks (TimeBanks USA) trade hours as currency in hundreds of communities.

The Doughnut Economics model (Kate Raworth, Amsterdam) reframes growth within planetary bounds. Together these programs form the attention meters foundation that Attention Market Exchanges will build on — the exchange logistics results, the opt-in ads methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as exchange logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Attention Market Exchanges
definition: Estimates Attention Market Exchanges readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Attention Market Exchanges components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a exchange hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Attention Market Exchanges operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Attention Market Exchanges installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 75649 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where attention meters monitoring, exchange logistics redundancy, or opt-in ads maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Attention Market Exchanges Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Attention Market Exchanges: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Attention Market Exchanges — markets pricing human attention fairly.

Phase 1 — Prove (attention meters): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (exchange logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (opt-in ads): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (revenue shares): exchange hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and media-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
